part_8.title: EXPOSURE
part_8.description: Physical presence requirements in designated affected areas

eligibility_criteria.note: Must meet ONE of the following presence requirements

options.description: Designated affected area for at least one year
Designated affected area for entire period
State of New Mexico for at least one year

exposure_option.label: Select all time periods when claimant was physically present

options.label: Designated affected area - at least one year (Jan 21, 1951 - Nov 6, 1962)
Designated affected area - entire period (Jun 30, 1962 - Jul 31, 1962)
State of New Mexico - at least one year (Sep 24, 1944 - Nov 6, 1962)

affected_areas.description: List all locations where claimant was physically present during eligible time periods

validation.rule: Must provide at least one location with time period that meets eligibility criteria
validation.error_message: If not physically present in any listed areas for required time period, you are not eligible for compensation

part_9.title: PROOF OF PRESENCE IN AN AFFECTED AREA
part_9.description: Documentation methods to establish physical presence in affected areas

acceptable_documents.note: Documents must show name of person who became ill (or immediate family member in same household), residence/employment in affected area, and specific date

certification_methods: Certified photocopies stamped with institutional seal (raised, colored, or signed)
Cover letter on letterhead from record source stating 'true and accurate copy'

lds_church_assistance.label: I have contacted the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and requested information regarding my claim
lds_church_assistance.note: Call (801) 240-3500 or write to: Member and Statistical Records Division, 17th Floor, 50 East North Temple Street, Salt Lake City, UT 84150

required_documents.note: Upload/attach documents showing presence in affected area during eligible time periods

part_14.description: Attorney must sign acknowledging fee limitations (only if attorney hired)

options.label: 2% for filing of an initial claim
10% for contract made before July 10, 2000 or resubmission of denied claim
